mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in a month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% in a month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in a month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase in the same month
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS both increase in the same month and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening financial conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% in a month during a tightening cycle and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.
